current_title_lines: 中国电力产能扩张提速
电网消纳与结构再平衡成关键
清洁能源如何支撑下一阶段增长

subtitles.zh: 想象一下，一年内建成一个国家的电力产能。
subtitles.en: Imagine building a country's power capacity in a single year.

subtitles.zh: 这基本上就是中国在2025年所做的。
subtitles.en: That's essentially what China did in 2025.

subtitles.zh: 它新增的电力足以匹配印度整个电力系统，超过500吉瓦，仅用12个月。
subtitles.en: It added enough power to match India's entire electricity system more than 500 gigawatts in just 12 months.

subtitles.zh: 这种增长和快速发展确实是前所未有的。
subtitles.en: This kind of growth and rapid development is really unprecedented.

subtitles.zh: 以2060年净零为目标，并将能源安全作为国家优先事项，北京正在释放史上最大的可再生能源建设。
subtitles.en: With the target of net zero by 2060, and with energy security as a national priority, Beijing is unleashing the biggest renewable energy buildouts

subtitles.zh: 这是世界前所未见的。中国已表明它能大规模建设可再生能源产能。
subtitles.en: the world has ever seen. China has showed that it can build renewable power capacity at scale.

subtitles.zh: 现在它需要证明自己能使用它。
subtitles.en: Now it needs the show that it can use it.

subtitles.zh: 因为目前，中国生产得太多了。
subtitles.en: Because right now, China is producing too much.

subtitles.zh: 仅在2026年上半年，一些估计表明浪费的风能和太阳能
subtitles.en: In just the first half of 2026, some estimates suggest the amount of wind and solar energy wasted

subtitles.zh: 足以供电整个法国。
subtitles.en: could have powered all of France.

subtitles.zh: 然而中国正押注人工智能、机器人和先进制造来推动下一阶段经济增长，
subtitles.en: And yet China is betting on AI, robotics and advanced manufacturing to drive its next phase of economic growth,

subtitles.zh: 这些都需要大量电力。
subtitles.en: all of which require vast amounts of power.

subtitles.zh: 因此希望打造近乎无限、廉价、清洁的电力层，供各行业使用。
subtitles.en: So that wants to create this layer of almost infinite, cheap, clean electricity that its industries can tap into.

subtitles.zh: 问题在于能否成功改造电网，利用所有这些能源而不使系统过载。
subtitles.en: The question is whether it can successfully rewire the grid to utilize all this energy without overloading the system.
